correctness.rationale: Fixing an (n-2)-clique gives four adjacency types for the two remaining vertices. Exact edge-type counts yield three closed formulas for the Szeged-Wiener gap, depending on whether the outside pair is adjacent and whether it has a common clique neighbor. Solving the resulting integer equalities leaves exactly the Zhang-Li family for all n >= 10 and one additional order-10 graph; the nonadjacent case has no equality solution for n >= 10.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. arXiv:2609.20025 explicitly poses the full eta(G)=2n equality classification and supplies one equality family while noting that it is not necessary. Searches of exact and synonymous formulations, clique-number/high-clique variants, diameter-two/complement formulations, and the direct reference chain found no prior classification of the omega(G) >= n-2 regime or the additional order-10 graph. The main residual risk is unindexed parallel work because the source problem is extremely recent.

value.rationale: The theorem gives a complete equality classification in a natural dense regime containing the entire known infinite equality construction. It proves eventual uniqueness of that family within omega(G) >= n-2, identifies the unique high-clique exception at n=10, and provides exact four-parameter formulas for all two-vertex extensions of a clique.

disclaimer: Not independent validation, peer review, or a guarantee of first discovery.
